A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Resampling Forcing work. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, tables, figures, and complete end matter. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original video-generation experiments, VBench scores in Tables 1–2, and qualitative ablation and routing analyses in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the work's original quantitative comparisons and qualitative experiments in Section 4. Results retained from v1 still constitute original empirical results.

M1.justification: Self-resampling with detached gradients, teacher-forcing warmup, the diffusion objective, and parameter-free top-k history routing remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 is rewritten as Python-style pseudocode without establishing a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain training on 5- and 15-second videos, evaluation of 15-second text-conditioned generation with VBench, and the same qualitative scenarios. No dataset, task, or domain coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SkyReels-V2, MAGI-1, NOVA, Pyramid Flow, CausVid, Self Forcing, and LongLive. The ablation comparators also remain unchanged. AAPT appears in v2's new explanatory diagram, not as a newly evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Reported training budgets, hyperparameters, inference settings, and VBench evaluation procedures are retained. Table 1's first interval changes from 0–15 s to 0–5 s, correcting its inconsistency with the three-segment protocol already stated in v1's caption and text.

E4.justification: Section 4.2 retains the same error-simulation, timestep-shift, sparse-history, and routing-frequency analyses with the same conditions and conclusions. More snapshots of the existing balloon examples and reordered fish panels change presentation rather than introduce another analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. The routing-frequency plots remain descriptive analyses, not uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All 81 scores in Table 1 and nine scores in Table 2 are identical. Qualitative findings and routing-frequency trends are retained. The expanded balloon storyboard and relocated fish panels present the existing examples without establishing changed outcomes.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and reasoning are retained. Equation (9) explicitly writes the cardinality restriction |Omega*| = k in v2, restating the k-frame selection already specified in v1's adjoining text. No substantive new assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof appears.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of teacher-free end-to-end training, reduced error accumulation, improved long-video consistency, and efficient history routing. The new overview diagram illustrates the existing contribution rather than redefining it.

C2.justification: v2 removes the Section 5 limitations paragraph acknowledging iterative-denoising latency, possible need for acceleration, and dual-sequence training overhead. The interpretations of error correction, causality, and history routing otherwise remain substantially unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4 drops v1's explicit disclosure that pretrained Wan2.1-1.3B weights initialize training, along with the source model's 81-frame, 480 × 832 specification. These are losses of technical disclosure, not evidence that initialization or experimental settings actually changed.

R1.justification: The same 88 cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. The new Self Forcing/AAPT schematic illustrates distinctions already discussed in v1; reference formatting, access dates, and corrected method-name spelling do not change the literature coverage.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammatical and terminology edits, revises author and affiliation formatting, shortens some descriptions, and rewrites Algorithm 1 in code-style language. The section hierarchy and overall scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The document receives extensive typography, margin, header, and figure-placement changes. v2 adds an overview diagram, rearranges the method illustration, redesigns Algorithm 1, expands the balloon storyboard from three to six frames per row, relocates routing panels, and corrects Table 1's interval header.

improvement.justification: The overview diagram, revised pseudocode, and corrected table header provide modest clarity gains. However, v2 removes explicit pretrained-initialization disclosure and the practical limitations discussion while retaining the same experiments and training-from-scratch claims. Those omissions reduce transparency about what the evidence demonstrates and the method's practical constraints, outweighing the presentation gains.
